hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.kt|*.kts|*strings.xml) jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:"Campfire code-style skill applies to this file (.claude/skills/code-style/SKILL.md): MPL-2.0 header on every new file; comments carry the why, never the what, as full-sentence prose; KDoc (/** */) for declarations, // only inside function bodies; always use trailing commas on multi-line lists; modifier: Modifier = Modifier is the first Composable parameter; commonMain stays JVM-free and every expect needs all four actuals; UI strings live in both values/ and values-hu/ strings.xml and are read with the localization stringResource; main files stay under 500 lines and top-level functions (Composables above all) under 120, so split while writing; delete whatever your change leaves unused; keep the module CLAUDE.md in sync; never commit unless asked."}}' ;; esac
